mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (user_id, provider, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{accessToken, typeHandler=com.ureca.unity.global.config.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, #{refreshToken, typeHandler=com.ureca.unity.global.config.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
